title: Just ok
text: Just ok. This looks like a trendy, inexpensive tv stand. It’s much smaller than I thought and I should have measured it. It took about 1.15 hrs to assemble. There is 1 shelf on the open side and 1 shelf behind the door. There are opening on the back for wires/cables to pass thru. The grey laminate has a few very teeny blemishes upon arrival. The metal brackets in the corners have glue visible in them.

product_metadata.title: AM alphamount TV Console Cabinet for TVs up to 50 Inch W/Media Shelves, Farmhouse TV Stand Style Entertainment Center for Soundbar or Other Media, Barn Door TV Stand with Storage, APRTS03D
features: [FITS WITH EXISTING DECOR]: Whether your decoration style is industrial, rustic, or traditional, this TV stand can fit in well with your room aesthetic. Natural wood grain and the charcoal gray color will add warmth and charm to any home.

[EASY TO ASSEMBLE]: Using the included manual and hardware, you can easily assemble this TV stand on your own with minimal hassle. The high-quality MDF wood boards are durable and scratch resistant to help prevent any unnecessary wear and tear

[MULTIFUNCTIONAL]: Not only does this unit function as a TV cabinet or entertainment center, it also works as a corridor table, entrance table, sofa table, display table, office storage, console table, shoe cabinet, and more. With a smooth, easy-to-clean surface that is moisture-resistant, the stand is a versatile solution for a variety of needs

[DECORATE YOUR HOME]: This TV console stand is designed with a gorgeous wood texture that adds character to any room. Place your sound bar, books, souvenirs, game console, photo frames, and more on the adjustable shelving or tabletop surface.

[STRONG AND STURDY]: The four legs of the unit are equipped with adjustment knobs to level and balance on uneven flooring as well as protect your floor from damage. The top shelf of the stand can hold up to 66 pounds.
